title.narrative: Programa de Desarrollo Municipal, Etapa II

description.narrative: THE OPERATION WOULD FINANCE A MUNICIPAL WORKS PROGRAM IN THE FOLLOWING AREAS: (A) WATER SUPPLY, (B) SEWERAGE, (C) MARKETS, (D) COMMUNITY CENTERS, (E) STREET PAVING, AND (F) BRIDGES; AS WELL AS (G) INSTITUTIONAL STRENGTHENING, AND (H) STUDIES AND DESIGNS FOR A POSSIBLE THIRD STAGE OF THE PROGRAM.
